Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: AetherPress
Description: Detects completed Penumbra mod installations and offers configurable Base, Normal, and Mask texture compression. Use /aetherpress to open settings.
Punchline: Automatically compress textures in newly installed Penumbra mods.
Changelog: Skips unreadable, unsupported, or abnormal texture files instead of failing the entire mod, while preserving atomic protection for genuine conversion failures.

Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: Synastry
Description: A Penumbra animation launcher for organizing, pairing, and synchronizing multi-actor animations.
Changelog: Restores recursive local PAP scanning so installed animations always appear, paced at one mod per frame while open and one per second in the background.
